entry.title: New: Bill 112 (2023) (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
"A BILL FOR AN ORDINANCE AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2024 BUDGET FOR THE COUNTY OF MAUI, REVENUES; DEPARTMENT OF FINANCE, COUNTYWIDE COSTS; AND APPENDIX A, PART II, GENERAL EXCISE TAX FUND AND GENERAL EXCISE TAX FUND - DEPARTMENT OF HAWAIIAN HOME LANDS" The purpose of this bill is to amend the Fiscal Year 2024 Budget, by 1) adding "General Excise Tax" to the section entitled "From Taxes, Fees and Assessments" in the amount of $20,000,000 and increasing the total accordingly; 2) adding two appropriations under Department of Finance, Countywide Costs; 3) revising the reference in Section 14 of the General Budget Provisions; and 4) adding the General Excise Tax Fund with conditional language for three projects.
